metadata.description: SRE skills: standardized security & reliability documents and Linux kernel troubleshooting.

plugins.name: sre-docs
plugins.description: Draft and review SRE documents (threat model, design review, IR plan, playbook, incident doc, recovery plan, postmortem, ...) based on Google's Building Secure and Reliable Systems.

plugins.name: sre-kernel
plugins.description: Read-only Linux kernel troubleshooting over SSH: triage, oops/panic/vmcore analysis, lockup and hung-task analysis, USE-method performance analysis.
